title: Two release batch sizes
hook: Toy releases pay a setup cost per batch. What does this arithmetic leave out?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Compute a batch-overhead trade and name the missing feedback benefit before judging a delivery practice.

misconception: A toy showing only setup cost can establish the best batch size for real delivery.
objective: Compute a batch-overhead trade and name the missing feedback benefit before judging a delivery practice.
